title: Pop out
brief: Curate's first real ad, for people who have never heard of Curate (TikTok, Reels, Shorts; a 4:5 cut for the Instagram feed). The single idea: your closet is already in your photos. Emma's phone lies on a desk showing her real camera roll; on Cat Walk's beat her real pieces burst out of her own photos with an overshoot, hold and sink back home, while the line types on behind them. The phone turns face-on and the roll match-cuts into the app's real scan of that same roll (same photos, same grid), her pieces arrive, the Wardrobe floats in depth, end card. From concept c14 and the founder's reference reel. 6 s is a seamless loop; 30 s adds Found 30 photos of you, Zee's cheer on the music's break, a look card and a try-on.
hook: 0–0.5 s: a phone on a desk shows a camera roll; on the drop a black leather jacket bursts out of one of her photos toward the lens.
disclosures: Emma is an AI-generated persona and her photos and try-on are AI-generated: turn on the platform AI label (TikTok "AI-generated content", Meta "AI info", YouTube "altered or synthetic content").
The app footage is real (Curate 1.5.0, build 262, Emma's account); the scan, the pieces and the Wardrobe are shown as they happen, sped up 1.3–1.6x in places.
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License (Cat Walk, Arulo): online and social ads are fine; no TV/radio, never register it with Content ID.
notes: Rendered: 9x16 at 6, 15 and 30 s and 4x5 at 15 s (the Instagram feed cut). The 4x5 6 s and 30 s compositions exist but have not been checked. Music from 29.04 s of Cat Walk so the first pop is on the drop; the 15 s and 30 s end as the track drops into its breaks (a natural button ending).
